content.text: Theo's 5 months, so he's close but not there yet. Most families start around 6 months, once he sits with little support, holds his head steady, and reaches for your food. Until then, milk is still all he needs. For now, let him watch you eat and sit in the high chair at family meals, so the setup feels familiar when you start. It's general guidance, and your provider can confirm timing at the 6-month visit.
